description: Na₂LiCl₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with six NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with six LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.69-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.73 Å) and two longer (2.74 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.73 Å) and two longer (2.74 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiCl₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.83 Å. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.73 Å) Li-Cl bond lengths. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six LiCl₆ octahedra and edges with twelve NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Li-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.67-2.74 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.73 Å) and two longer (2.76 Å) Li-Cl bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to five Na and one Li atom to form ClNa₅Li octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₅Li octahedra and edges with twelve ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₅Li octahedra and edges with twelve ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and two Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Li atoms to form ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ClNa₅Li octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Li atoms to form ClNa₂Li₄ octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ClNa₅Li octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Li atoms to form ClNa₂Li₄ octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ClNa₅Li octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Cl-Na bond lengths are 2.69 Å.
